docs.content:
# Senior Software Engineer

**Email:** engineer@example.com | **Phone:** +91 9876543210 | **Location:** Bangalore, India  
**GitHub:** [github.com/sudo69](https://github.com/sudo69) | **LinkedIn:** [linkedin.com/in/software-engineer](https://linkedin.com)

---

## Professional Summary
Software Engineer with 3.5+ years of experience in architecting distributed backend services, full-stack web applications, and AI/RAG-driven workflows. Proven record in reducing API latency, containerizing microservices, and leading high-velocity deployments.

---

## Technical Skills
- **Languages:** Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, Bash
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** FastAPI, Flask, Django, React, Next.js, Node.js, PyTorch
- **AI & RAG:** LLM API Integrations, Vector Databases (Chroma, FAISS), Retrieval-Augmented Generation, LangChain
- **Databases & Caching:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB
- **DevOps & Cloud:** Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (EC2, S3, RDS), GitHub Actions, Terraform, Linux

---

## Work History
### **Software Engineer | Tech Innovations** (2022 – Present)
- Designed and maintained high-throughput RESTful microservices using FastAPI and PostgreSQL handling 20M+ monthly requests.
- Integrated RAG-powered semantic search pipelines improving internal query relevance by 45%.
- Reduced database read latencies by 35% through Redis caching layers and query index optimizations.
- Orchestrated containerized deployments via Docker and Kubernetes on AWS.

### **Associate Software Developer | CloudScale Labs** (2021 – 2022)
- Built interactive client-facing dashboards in React with real-time WebSocket feeds.
- Automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, cutting release deployment cycles by 50%.

---

## Featured GitHub & Open Source Projects
- **RAG-AG-Apply:** Autonomous job application and profile synchronization system using RAG knowledge bases and Antigravity CLI.
- **Distributed Cache Engine:** Lightweight high-concurrency key-value store in Python and Redis.
- **API Gateway Starter:** Production-grade gateway supporting rate limiting, JWT validation, and reverse proxy routing.

---

## Education
**Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science & Engineering**  
First Class with Distinction
